div.div:
1. Simulator requests token from Entra
(client_id + secret/cert + scope)
2. Entra returns access_token
(iss, aud, appid, roles)
3. Simulator opens Barrage session
EntraOidcAuthenticationHandler + TOKEN
4. Deephaven validates JWT via JWKS
and admits AuthContext
5. Publish / subscribe to tables

div.div:
1. Register deephaven-api, set Application ID URI, create app role Deephaven.Access
2. Register deephaven-order-simulator, client secret or public certificate
3. Simulator API permissions: Application permission on deephaven-api
4. Grant admin consent for the tenant
5. Scope for MSAL: api://API-CLIENT-ID/.default
6. Verify token with curl + jwt.ms (iss, aud, appid)
7. Point Deephaven issuer-uri + audience at same tenant / API URI
8. Run OrderSimulator with AUTH_PROVIDER=entra
